question.order_text: I'd like a pizza to help lower my risk of heart disease, type 2 diabetes, obesity, and some forms of cancer... with basil.
question.clarification_text: Whole wheat was what I was going for... with basil.

question.order_text: I want a tomato sauce pizza with meat and eggplant but I don't like them touching each other.
question.clarification_text: Tomato sauce pizza with meats on one side, eggplant on the other.

question.order_text: One Meat Lovers and two Green Dreams!
question.clarification_text: One pizza with pepperoni, sausage, bacon, and ham. Two pizzas bell pepper and basil!

question.order_text: Feels like an all meat pizza kind of day. Not the fancy meats though.
question.clarification_text: Just sausage and pepperoni. The classic meats.

question.order_text: Double order of Puttanesca on tomato sauce.
question.clarification_text: Two Puttanesca pizzas with tomato sauce.

question.order_text: I want a pizza that dances! Let's do a half-spicy tango and half-fruity ballet! Eight slices.
question.clarification_text: Eight slices of pizza. Four slices should have spicy toppings. The other four should have fruits.

question.order_text: Basil and apples. Make that two to go.
question.clarification_text: What can I say? I've got simple taste. Two cheese pizzas with basil and apples, please.

question.order_text: I'm so hungry I can't even think. Just throw everything you have on a pie.
question.clarification_text: My brain is too fried to think about toppings. Add all the ones you have on a cheese pizza, please.

question.order_text: Gimme three apple, onion, and pepperoni pizzas! 24 slices total!
question.clarification_text: Just like my apples, I like my pizza slices small. Cut three pizzas with apple, onion, and pep into eight slices each!

question.order_text: Everybody wants this. Everybody wants to be like me, eating a peach pizza with chicken.
question.clarification_text: By all means, move at a glacial pace as you make my cheese pizza with peach and chicken. You know how that thrills me.

question.order_text: What's the best food to eat while watching the game? Chips and dip! Or better yet, cheese on a crispy flatbread!
question.clarification_text: I love eating melty cheese on dough when I'm watching the game. Dark crust, please!

question.order_text: Three pizzas with pesto. Make one chicken, one olive, and one mushroom.
question.clarification_text: Just to be clear, each of those should be its own pizza: chicken, olives, mushrooms. But put pesto on all three.

question.order_text: I'll take a salty-sweet pineapple and olive pie, please.
question.clarification_text: Pineapple and olive on a pizza.

question.order_text: So, I heard that people are shipping pesto and seafood together. I'm TOTALLY onboard for that!
question.clarification_text: I mean... pesto, cheese, anchovies, and shrimp? It's the best food combo since PB&J!

question.order_text: One spicy Meat Lovers and two veggie pizzas!
question.clarification_text: One pizza with pepperoni, sausage, bacon, ham, and your spicy toppings. Two pizzas with all of your vegetables!

question.order_text: A voice spoke to me in a dream last night, saying: "Apples stay afloat on the sea". What could it mean?
question.clarification_text: I think it means I should eat apples...and seafood. In fact, put it all on a cheese pizza!

question.order_text: Flatbread with fungi. Make it crispy.
question.clarification_text: I want fungi on crispy dough.

question.order_text: I want a Coastal Classic and a not-so-classic meat! Just give me all of them on that second pie, thanks.
question.clarification_text: Sorry, I thought I was being clever. I want a Coastal classic and a pizza with all your meat toppings, thanks.

question.order_text: I need a pizza that represents my mood today: peppy and corny.
question.clarification_text: Pepperoni and corn on a deliciously delicious pizza!

question.order_text: Pesto is the best! Avocado makes me feel like I won the lotto. I was born to eat corn. And if I'm not mistaken, all these ingredients taste great with bacon.
question.clarification_text: Sorry, I was listening to Pepperonye West in the car. Just give me avocado, corn, and bacon on a cheese pizza with pesto.

question.order_text: I want one pizza with seafood, one fruity pig, and one Stinky Pete. But could you add avocado to each one and cut them into 8 slices?
question.clarification_text: Seafood toppings on one; red meat, olive, bell pepper, and pineapple on two; anchovies and onions on three. All should have cheese, sauce, and avocado. Cut them four times.
Yeah... um... olive pizza.

question.order_text: One fruity pizza for me, please!
question.clarification_text: Yeah, a pizza with all your fruits. Thanks!

question.order_text: I'll take 3 Meat Lovers pizzas. Make one with pesto sauce.
question.clarification_text: Three cheese pizzas with pep, sausage, bacon, and ham. Use pesto sauce instead of tomato sauce for one of them.

question.order_text: I'd like an apple pizza, please! Both the pine- and non-pine varieties, preferably.
question.clarification_text: A cheese pizza with both apple and pineapple. That'll do it for me.

question.order_text: I love meat, but my friend is pescatarian. Can you come to a compromise for us?
question.clarification_text: Fine, I guess I'm the one that has to figure out a solution. Half meat for me, half seafood for my friend.

question.order_text: One Coastal Classic and one of those no-sauce scallop and truffle ones, please.
question.clarification_text: Two very different pizzas. First one is sauce and cheese with scallop and shrimp and basil. Second is just cheese with scallop and truffle, no sauce.

question.order_text: I want a fruity autumn topping I can share with my cat!
question.clarification_text: I read that pumpkin in small portions is a good treat for them!

question.order_text: If you really like me, you'll make me two Coastal Classics.
question.clarification_text: Two Coastal Classics! Scallops, shrimp, and basil.

question.order_text: One side meat on wheat, one side jalapeño flatbread. I'm helping a friend sweat out a fever!
question.clarification_text: Put all your meat toppings with sauce and cheese on half of my pizza, and on the other half just do jalapeños on flatbread. All on wheat!

question.order_text: Winner winner, chicken dinner!
question.clarification_text: I won a couple rounds in my game. Now I'm treating myself to a chicken pizza!

question.order_text: Enough talk. More pizza! Darken two cheese pizzas in the oven.
question.clarification_text: Two cheese pizzas, double-baked. Sound good?

question.order_text: I want a Classic Meat, I want a Meat Lovers, and I want a...Green Dream!
question.clarification_text: 3 cheese pizzas! The first with pep and sausages. The second with pep, sausage, bacon, and ham. The third with bell pepper and basil.

question.order_text: Normally, I wouldn't think to put pesto on a cheese pizza. But that guy in the green shirt was very convincing!
question.clarification_text: Time to try something new! I'll have a cheese pizza with pesto sauce!

question.order_text: Spice up a Classic Meat! Dark crust.
question.clarification_text: Pepperoni, sausage, and all spicy toppings on dough, sauce, and cheese! Run it through the oven twice.

question.order_text: Let's do a half vegetarian and half anchovy flatbread on wheat, okay?
question.clarification_text: One side vegetarian on cheese and sauce, one side just anchovy on wheat dough.

question.order_text: I am SO hungry. Can I have two chicken pizzas with onion?
question.clarification_text: Two pizzas with chicken and onion, pretty please!

question.order_text: Everything here looks so delicious, but my stomach is weak to any meat or cheese...
question.clarification_text: I guess I meant a vegan pizza. Just veggies, fruits, and fungi.

question.order_text: My siblings and I want to settle a bet. I think pumpkin is the best with olives and onions, my sister likes it with sausage, and the other just likes it by itself. Make the pizzas, and we'll see who's right.
question.clarification_text: One pumpkin pizza with olives and onions. Another with pumpkin and sausage. The last with just pumpkin. All with sauce and cheese!

question.order_text: On my pizza, I want chicken. But also, what chickens eat!
question.clarification_text: Most chicken feed has corn in it. I guess that's kind of a useless fun fact though, isn't it?

question.order_text: Lots of olives! Olives and sausage! Three pizzas!
question.clarification_text: Three pizzas with olives and sausages!

question.order_text: Three pizzas with pesto. One of them should have basil and figs, two of them should be Fruity Pigs.
question.clarification_text: I'd like two Fruity Pigs and one pizza with figs and basil. Pesto and cheese on all three.

question.order_text: Three P pizza, please.
question.clarification_text: Pepperoni, Pepper, and Pineapple pizza, please.

question.order_text: When was the last time you just sat and enjoyed a pizza? I want to have that moment with an Apple Crisp.
question.clarification_text: No distractions, just a moment between me and a perfectly cooked Apple Crisp pie.

question.order_text: My mother makes amazing zucchini wheat bread. I wonder how yours pairs with shrimp, cheese, and a basil dip?
question.clarification_text: Pesto would suffice as a replacement basil dip, so that, cheese, and shrimp on one side. Zucchini flatbread on the other. On wheat.

question.order_text: Gotta get myself a pizza with pepperoni.
question.clarification_text: You heard me right, pepperoni me up on a cheese pizza!

question.order_text: Can I get half chicken parm, half creamy pesto shrimp?
question.clarification_text: Sorry, I was trying to be fancy. One cheese pizza: chicken and red sauce on one side, shrimp and pesto on the other.

question.order_text: A Fruity Pig and a Vegetarian pizza sound downright heavenly right now.
question.clarification_text: A Fruity Pig: pepperoni, sausage, ham, bacon, olives, bell pepper, and pineapple. Vegetarian: sauce, cheese, and all your non-meat ingredients.

question.order_text: HAM! I WANT HAM!
question.clarification_text: I really like ham.

question.order_text: Gimme a half Salty Sailor and half Stinky Pete.
question.clarification_text: An anchovy pizza with olive on one side and onion on the other.

question.order_text: Gimme one Green Dream, one Stinky Pete, and one onion zucchini jalapeno pie. Pesto on all three!
question.clarification_text: Three pizzas with pesto and cheese. One of them should have onions, zucchini, and jalapeno. One of them should be a Green Dream. The other, a Stinky Pete.

question.order_text: Peach fuzz is meant to protect the fruit from insects! I just use garlic to repel insects. One peach and garlic pie, please!
question.clarification_text: If it works, it works! Bake one cheese pizza with peach and garlic!

question.order_text: Meat on red, artichokes on anything, cheese on everything, in one pizza.
question.clarification_text: Sorry, just all your meats on red sauce on one side, artichokes on either sauce on the other side. Don't forget the cheese!

question.order_text: A duck walked up to a pizza stand, and he said to the man running the stand, "Hey! Got any Vegetarians?" Make me that vegetarian pizza— and a duck pizza to keep it company!
question.clarification_text: I'll have a Vegetarian like the duck, but I'll also get a duck pizza!

question.order_text: Have you ever seen the movie Za Wars? I heard the color of Luke Piewalker's bite-saber was inspired by a soft green fruit, a crunchy green fruit, and green sauce!
question.clarification_text: I guess I'd like a cheese pizza with pesto sauce, plus avocado and bell peppers.

question.order_text: Sliced tomatoes on pesto sounds delicious! But then again, having them with tomato sauce makes sense...
question.clarification_text: If only I could have pesto on one side and red sauce on the other... then I could enjoy all the cheesy, tomato-y goodness!

question.order_text: A Capricciosa and a Vegetarian. The Capricciosa's got the ham I actually want — the Vegetarian's just so I can pretend I'm being healthy.
question.clarification_text: A Capricciosa and a Vegetarian. Ham won't be lonely in my stomach!

question.order_text: I'm feeling like a princess today. Could you bake me a peach pizza?
question.clarification_text: I want to be a peach princess eating peach on dough, sauce, and cheese!

question.order_text: I need one pizza with pepperoni, mushrooms, olives, and sausage, and another just cheese.
question.clarification_text: Some of us are more complex than others.

question.order_text: Can I have a flatbread with pesto sauce on one side only? Put sliced tomatoes and chicken on it, too. But don't let the sliced tomatoes touch the pesto sauce!
question.clarification_text: Make a flatbread with pesto sauce on half of it, sliced tomatoes on the other, and chicken on both sides!

question.order_text: A pork pizza is the bane of my existence and the object of my desires.
question.clarification_text: I cannot imagine my life without a pizza with all your pork toppings.

question.order_text: Double order of pumpkin-corn pizzas. Use wheat dough for one of 'em!
question.clarification_text: Bake two pizzas with pumpkin and corn toppings! One on wheat and one on regular dough.

question.order_text: I'd like half cheese bread and half sauce bread. Make that a double.
question.clarification_text: Two half sauce and half cheese.

question.order_text: People say pineapple doesn't belong on pizza... But what if you added jalapenos?
question.clarification_text: I know, it sounds crazy... Crazy enough to work! Gimme a jalapeno and pineapple pizza!

question.order_text: Give me half a meat pie and then on the other side green greens to balance it out.
question.clarification_text: Half meat, half green.

question.order_text: I'll have half vegetarian on pesto for health, half duck flatbread for fun. Put it on the wheat dough.
question.clarification_text: Start with wheat dough. Then, pesto, cheese, and vegetarian toppings on half, and just duck on dough for the other half.

question.order_text: I'll take a Meat Lover's. And make sure you use red sauce!
question.clarification_text: Pepperoni, sausage, ham, bacon? Heck, even cheese tastes SO much better with red sauce!

question.order_text: I'm so hungry! Please combine Classic Meat and Capricciosa toppings on one pizza!
question.clarification_text: Top a cheese pizza with pepperoni, sausage, mushroom, olive, ham, and artichoke!

question.order_text: Part of me really wants a vegetarian pizza on wheat, and part of me really wants duck flatbread... AHH! Okay, okay, can you do... BOTH??
question.clarification_text: I really love wheat dough so I need that. Half of it should be a regular vegetarian pizza, and the other half should be just duck on dough.

question.order_text: Bake me a pie with the juiciest red fruit! 8 slices.
question.clarification_text: A sliced tomato pie, please! Cut in half four times.

question.order_text: I would like a vegan version of a Supreme pizza, please!
question.clarification_text: A vegan Supreme with sauce, mushroom, olive, onion, and bell pepper! Don't add cheese, pep, or sausage.

question.order_text: Mind making me a crispy pizza? Fruits on one side.
question.clarification_text: A cheese pizza with fruits on one half and no toppings on the other.

question.order_text: Herb and onion on wheat.
question.clarification_text: Herb? Oh. Basil.

question.order_text: Please heat sweet wheat with meat for me to eat.
question.clarification_text: Meat pizza on whole wheat.

question.order_text: You miss 100% of the pizzas you don't order, so I'm ordering three pesto pizzas. Make each 50% ham and 50% Onion.
question.clarification_text: Cover 100% of dough with pesto sauce and cheese. Then add ham to half and onion to the other half. Don't forget to triple the order!

question.order_text: My favorite meal is fried chicken with corn and basil, plus sweet figs to balance the flavors.
question.clarification_text: Let's see, that would be...chicken, corn, basil, and figs!

question.order_text: Meat. Fruit. Different sides of the pizza. Got it?
question.clarification_text: I want all your meats and fruits on my pizza, but they have to be on different sides.

question.order_text: I'd like two pizzas with pesto, mushrooms and sausage. And on one of those, can I get onions on one half?
question.clarification_text: Both pizzas should have pesto, mushrooms, and sausage. But one should also have onions on one half.

question.order_text: I'm gonna need a pumpkin pizza. Add basil for a bit of extra flavor!
question.clarification_text: I think pumpkin and basil would pair well together.

question.order_text: I wish I were a mermaid... A part of that world where they swim all day! For now, I'll settle for a fig pie with veggies.
question.clarification_text: I would trade anything for a cheese pizza with fig and veggies!

question.order_text: I'll take two wheat pizzas with all your meats, please.
question.clarification_text: Add all your meats to two cheese pizzas. Make sure to use wheat dough.

question.order_text: I had the most delicious roast duck with a balsamic fig glaze when I went to France! I only wished it didn't have balsamic in it...and that it was on a pizza...
question.clarification_text: I think the dish would've tasted better with only duck and fig. With sauce and cheese instead of balsamic vinegar.

question.order_text: RED! Gotta have it red! Pink is fine, but NO CHEESE! Cheese is not red!
question.clarification_text: Make it as red as you can! Tomato sauce, pepperoni, ham, shrimp, bacon, anything red and pink!

question.order_text: I'd love it if my wheaty pizza was meaty on one side, plain apple on the other. Pesto and cheese on the meat side, nothing on the apple side.
question.clarification_text: Pesto, cheese, and meat on one side, apple flatbread on the other side. All on wheat dough.

question.order_text: Pizza is a funny thing. So delicious, yet fleeting. I want to savor one with pineapple.
question.clarification_text: I want the taste of pineapple to linger on my cheese pizza.

question.order_text: I'm picky... I don't like sauce... or cheese... but I want pumpkin. Can you just put that on some dough, please?
question.clarification_text: Literally, just pumpkin on cooked dough. I really don't like sauce or cheese.

question.order_text: My family loves meat, but my cholesterol's getting too high. Half meat pie on the red sauce for them, half cheese and zucchini for me.
question.clarification_text: Half should have tomato sauce and all your meats. The other half should have any sauce, cheese, and zucchini.

question.order_text: Paradise always seems just out of reach...until now! Bake me a Paradise Pie!
question.clarification_text: Bell pepper, shrimp, and pineapple are a delight on pizza!

question.order_text: Make a pizza with 180 degrees of white toppings!
question.clarification_text: One cheese pizza with white toppings on one half!

question.order_text: I'm spending the day with my crush, hehe! Two Sunset Medley pizzas, please! Add green toppings to one of them.
question.clarification_text: Two cheese pizzas with pineapple, peach, and sliced tomato will set the perfect mood for our day! Add your green toppings to one of them! Don't forget to use tomato sauce.

question.order_text: Hey, is it weird to ask for corn on pizza? I'm just really curious about it.
question.clarification_text: No, you know what? It's not weird. I'm excited to try corn on my pizza!

question.order_text: Do you have wheat dough? Okay, I kind of want something new. Ehh, maybe an all-fruit pizza, but with some black diamonds?
question.clarification_text: I mean truffle. All fruit pizza with truffle. The diamond of the kitchen, you know!

question.order_text: I'm a vegetarian, but my friend is an ogre. He only eats meat. Half olive and onion, half nothing but ham, please!
question.clarification_text: We'd like one pizza that's half olive and onion, and the other half just ham – not even cheese or sauce on that half!

question.order_text: Hey! Hey, listen. Shhh...listen, Ovenist. I...want...a...SPICY PEACH PIZZA!
question.clarification_text: Did you hear that? Dough, sauce, cheese, peach, and spicy toppings!

question.order_text: I'm meatmaxxing. I'll take a meat pizza on tomato sauce.
question.clarification_text: Just give me all your meat toppings on a regular cheese with tomato sauce.

question.order_text: I want a watermelon pizza, with no cheese!
question.clarification_text: You put tomato sauce and olives on one half, pesto on the other. But no cheese!

question.order_text: Do you know what ratatouille is? I want that, but on a pizza!
question.clarification_text: Oh, it's a vegetarian dish. Just put eggplants, bell peppers, onions and basil on a cheese pizza.

question.order_text: I'd like a classic meat on classic wheat with a classic zucchini treat and peppers with that classic heat!
question.clarification_text: Pepperoni, sausage, zucchini, and all the peppers you have. Put it on wheat dough with red sauce and cheese.

question.order_text: I want a pesto pizza with pepperoni and sausage. And I want another with olives and onions on one side, mushrooms on the other.
question.clarification_text: Sorry, it's a long order... Two pesto pizzas, one with pepperoni and sausage. The other should have two halves: one side mushroom, the other onions and olives.

question.order_text: I can't decide if a supreme pizza would taste better with pesto or pizza sauce. Can I get one half/half?
question.clarification_text: That's pepperoni, sausage, onions, olives, mushrooms, and bell peppers. But make one half pesto, one half red sauce.
